digest.component_or_area: bridge state rotation bookkeeping and persistence
propositions: GET-rotation timestamps must move from inline bindings.json into .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar while maintaining backward compatibility with old binaries.
New binaries must write both legacy inline field and new sidecar file, then read the chronological maximum of both to ensure correct ordering during mixed-version deployments.
The rotation state module must be extracted as a cohesive cluster in get_rotation.py to respect the 800-line policy on binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py without duplicating sidecar scaffolding.
Sidecar file must be persisted only through BindingStore.save() to ensure reconcile-check with persist=False does not create get_rotation.json.
Explicit git staging path and basename membership checks must include GET_ROTATION_FILE so local reconciliation commits the sidecar without relying on git add -A.
